question: During the 2022 Commonwealth Games held in Birmingham, how many medals did India win?
solution:
The correct answer is __**61.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **2022 Commonwealth Games:-**

 
 
• India won a total of 61 medals in the 2022 Commonwealth Games held in Birmingham.
 
• Out of the 61 medals, India won 22 gold, 16 silver, and 23 bronze medals.
 
• This was India's best performance in the Commonwealth Games, surpassing their previous record of 64 medals in the 2010 Delhi Games.
 
• India finished Fourth in the overall medal tally behind Australia and England.
 
• India's success was largely due to their strong performances in shooting, wrestling, and athletics.
